items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I played the bass with another boy named, uh, we always called him Don Raymond. See, I played with him and he had a big band

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. So, right after that, I had played with Howard quite a while. And I played the bass with another boy named, uh, we always called him Don Raymond. See, I played with him and he had a big band, you see. Well, playing with him, it gave me a chance to get more acquainted with the bass because he did have music, you see. He used to play a lot of fun music, you see.
I forgot to ask you, when you learned to read music, did you work that out by yourself? Or some of these people helped you, like, uh, the guitar? Well, that's something I forgot.
